notes:
New: see which buffs are running on an account. A small mark beside the status of each bot for the buffs it has on - Penicillin, Ivory Horn, Ultra Corselet, Castle Buff, Truce, Holiday and broken gates. Hover any of them for how long is left. RELAUNCH YOUR BOTS after updating - the reporting script is what reads them, and a running bot keeps the old one. You pick which ones appear under Settings, Appearance, Buff badges, or turn the lot off for a clean list.
Three kinds of alert that had never once fired. Holiday alerts, broken-gate alerts and the account-level attack backstop were reading four fields the page was never sent, so they silently did nothing for months. The same gap made the Prestige monitor list shielded players as inactive targets. All four work now.
The Alerts page is 6.3 times lighter - one request of 277KB instead of seven totalling 1.7MB, twice a minute.
The pop-out window is right again. It was broken in 1.36.8, where the new red ! mark stopped the status column clipping in the pop-out as well as the main window.
Group cards can be dragged into order on the Groups tab, the buttons on every bot row are bigger and all one size, and a maximised window reopens maximised.
